parameters.jsCode:
const j = $input.first().json;
const topic = j['Video Topic'] || '';
const mins = j['Video Length (minutes)'] || 10;
const style = j['Style'] || 'Tutorial';

const prompt = [
  'You are a senior YouTube producer and n8n expert with 10 years of experience.',
  'Create a complete production package for this video:',
  '',
  'Topic: ' + topic,
  'Target length: ' + mins + ' minutes',
  'Style: ' + style,
  '',
  'Return ONLY this exact Markdown structure:',
  '',
  '# TITLE OPTIONS',
  'Three click-worthy title options.',
  '',
  '# HOOK',
  'The first 15 seconds of the video, word for word.',
  '',
  '# FULL SCRIPT',
  'Complete script, section by section, with [B-ROLL: description] cues and real n8n node names in every step.',
  '',
  '# DESCRIPTION',
  'YouTube description with 3 hashtags at the end.',
  '',
  '# TAGS',
  '20 comma-separated tags.',
  '',
  '# THUMBNAIL TEXT',
  'Max 4 words, high impact.',
  '',
  'Rules: energetic YouTube creator tone, concrete and actionable, zero fluff, everything in English.'
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { body: { contents: [{ parts: [{ text: prompt }] }] } } }];
